verdict.rationale: Evidence shows skills are stored as SKILL.md markdown files organized in folders (e.g. review/SKILL.md, qa/SKILL.md, ship/SKILL.md), which are plain text and readable/copyable, and dev mode even symlinks the repo of skills into another harness's directory (.claude/skills/), supporting some portability. However, this is Claude-specific tooling and there's no explicit statement that skills are harness-agnostic plain files usable directly by arbitrary other agents/binary-free across all supported hosts. missing for 10: explicit cross-harness carry documentation beyond Claude Code, confirmation no compiled/binary component is required for skill execution, and independent verification of format openness.
